battle.name: 阿塞拜疆-亞美尼亞戰爭
battle.brief: 阿塞拜疆-亞美尼亞戰爭於1918年在外高加索爆發，阿塞拜疆民主共和國與亞美尼亞方面的武裝在納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫及贊格祖爾一帶交戰。同期英國海軍已列裝魚雷艇（Torpedo boat，1877年），其角色是快速近海襲擊，供偵察、追擊與海上攔截。

kit.name: 魚雷艇
kit.history: 魚雷艇在英國皇家海軍體系中屬輕型近海快速襲擊艦艇，負責前沿偵察、追擊敵艦與巡邏高危海域，並可掩護登陸或協助主力艦隊作戰。

countries: 這場戰爭通常稱為1918年的阿塞拜疆－亞美尼亞戰爭，但實際戰線不能只按兩個後來成立的共和國來劃分。四月下旬投入作戰的亞美尼亞武裝，主要來自亞美尼亞民族委員會、亞拉臘政府及其控制的混合部隊；第一共和國直到五月二十八日才正式宣布成立。阿塞拜疆方面則包括穆沙瓦特組織、阿塞拜疆政府各地方部隊，以及四月間先在納赫奇瓦凡成立並擁有武裝的納赫奇瓦凡政府。奧斯曼帝國軍隊自安納托利亞東進，與納赫奇瓦凡及阿塞拜疆部隊協同作戰，並在五月九日迫使亞美尼亞方面的守軍撤出卡爾斯。俄國的南高加索委員會在四月十二日解散，帝國軍行政權與駐軍隨之瓦解，使卡爾斯、阿爾達漢、札涅古爾、納赫奇瓦凡、朱爾法及阿拉斯河沿岸同時出現權力真空。喬治亞並非主要交戰方，但卡爾斯－第比利斯鐵路曾構成聯絡與補給通道。題名雖是兩國之戰，奧斯曼軍的介入與俄軍撤離卻是理解全程不可缺少的條件。
countriesEn: The conflict is usually called the 1918 Azerbaijani–Armenian War, but its fronts cannot be explained solely through two republics that had not yet been established when the fighting began. The Armenian forces committed in late April consisted mainly of troops organized by the Armenian National Council, the Ararat government, and mixed units under their authority; the First Republic of Armenia did not formally declare independence until 28 May. The Azerbaijani side included Musavat organizations, formations of the Azerbaijani government, and the Nakhchivan Government, which had already organized armed forces in April. Ottoman troops advanced eastward from Anatolia, operated alongside Nakhchivan and Azerbaijani formations, and forced the Armenian defenders out of Kars on 9 May. The Transcaucasian Commissariat of Russia dissolved on 12 April, and the departure of imperial officers and garrisons created a simultaneous vacuum in Kars, Ardahan, Zangezur, Nakhchivan, Jolfa, and the Aras valley. Georgia was not a principal belligerent, although the Kars–Tiflis railway served as a communications and supply route. Thus, despite the bilateral title, Ottoman intervention and the Russian collapse are indispensable to understanding the campaign from beginning to end.
people: 卡爾斯方向的奧斯曼作戰由Kazım Karabekir指揮，他把鐵路運輸、野戰炮兵與步兵集中使用，並以五月九日奪取卡爾斯成為此次戰役最明確的戰術成果。亞美尼亞方面的Hamazaspian率領主力部隊在札涅古爾作戰，負責突破山口、維持梅赫里至奧爾杜巴德的供應線；Andranik則率領較獨立的義勇與騎兵支隊參與札涅古爾、納赫奇瓦凡方向的行動，但他不是亞美尼亞全軍的總司令。納赫奇瓦凡政府的首腦Javad Khan主持當地行政與軍事準備，組織守軍、控制道路和徵集地方武裝。Ali bey Huseynzade在阿塞拜疆方面參與接收俄軍裝備與建立軍事指揮體系，Mammad Amin Rasulzade則代表穆沙瓦特與阿塞拜疆民族政治當局決定外交及戰略方向。亞美尼亞代表Alexander Khatisian後來在六月二日參與簽署《亞歷山德羅波爾條約》。這些人物各自掌握政治授權、戰區指揮或地方資源，不能把全部戰果歸於任何一名單一指揮官。
peopleEn: Kazım Karabekir directed the Ottoman operation toward Kars, concentrating railway transport, field artillery, and infantry, and the capture of the city on 9 May became the clearest tactical success of the campaign. On the Armenian side, Hamazasp Hamazaspian led the principal grouping in Zangezur, directing efforts to break through the mountain passes and maintain the supply route between Meghri and Ordubad. Andranik Torkomian participated with separate volunteer and cavalry detachments in operations around Zangezur and Nakhchivan, although he was not commander of the entire Armenian force. Javad Khan, head of the Nakhchivan Government, directed local administration and military preparation, organized the defenders, controlled the roads, and brought armed formations into the field. Ali bey Huseynzade helped receive former Russian equipment and establish an Azerbaijani command structure, while Mammad Amin Rasulzade represented the Musavat political leadership and determined its diplomatic and strategic direction. Alexander Khatisian subsequently represented Armenia in the Treaty of Alexandropol on 2 June. These men possessed political authority, operational command, or local resources in different combinations, and the campaign's results cannot properly be attributed to any single commander.
kits: 雙方軍械不是單一的新式裝備，而是俄軍撤離留下的武器與各自原有軍械混用。亞美尼亞及阿塞拜疆地方部隊可取得俄製Mosin–Nagant 1891型步槍、1895型Nagant手槍，以及架在Sokolov車架上的Maxim 1910型水冷重機槍；部分俄軍庫存的76.2毫米1902年型野戰炮也被地方部隊接收，但炮組、瞄準器材與專用炮彈是否齊備，必須視具體駐地而定。奧斯曼軍主要使用1895年型Mauser步槍及德製Maxim MG 08重機槍，後者以7.92毫米彈藥為主；1895年型Mauser使用7.65毫米彈藥，俄製步槍則使用7.62毫米54R彈藥。不同口徑使前線無法依靠一條統一補給線解決消耗，卡爾斯方向還能利用鐵路輸送炮彈與馬車，札涅古爾山區則主要依靠步兵背囊、馱馬、馬車和馱騏逐段搬運。軍用電話與電報可用於固定據點，戰場指揮仍大量依賴傳令兵。各支部隊的裝備並不相同，因此裝備清單只能說明當時可能使用的實物種類，不能假定每名士兵都攜帶所有槍械。
kitsEn: The opposing forces did not field uniform new equipment; they combined weapons left behind by departing Russian units with their own inventories. Armenian and Azerbaijani formations could obtain Russian Mosin–Nagant Model 1891 rifles, Nagant Model 1895 revolvers, and Maxim Model 1910 heavy machine guns on Sokolov wheeled mounts. Some stocks of Russian 76.2 mm Model 1902 field guns also passed to local formations, although the availability of trained crews, sighting equipment, and dedicated artillery ammunition depended on the station. The Ottoman Army primarily used Model 1895 Mauser rifles and German Maxim MG 08 heavy machine guns, the latter normally firing 7.92 mm ammunition. The Mauser Model 1895 used 7.65 mm ammunition, while the Russian rifle used 7.62 mm 54R ammunition. These incompatible calibers prevented any single supply route from solving consumption. Railways could move artillery ammunition and wagons toward Kars, but in the mountains of Zangezur movement depended on infantry loads, pack horses, carts, and mules working in short relay stages. Field telephones and telegraph lines served fixed posts, yet couriers still carried much of the tactical traffic. The equipment mix varied sharply between formations, so these items represent real weapons available in 1918 rather than a claim that every unit carried every item.
tactics: 四月下旬，亞美尼亞部隊主要循埃里溫－卡潘－梅赫里的公路與山道向札涅古爾推進，再分向奧爾杜巴德、梅赫里和納赫奇瓦凡；其核心目標是打通南部通路，並使分散在札涅古爾與納赫奇瓦凡的亞美尼亞武裝可以會合。阿塞拜疆與納赫奇瓦凡部隊則依托納赫奇瓦凡－奧爾杜巴德－朱爾法道路及阿拉斯河沿岸固定陣地，以前哨、騎兵巡邏和機槍射擊限制對方縱深。奧斯曼軍在卡爾斯建立集中出發點，利用卡爾斯－第比利斯與卡爾斯－朱爾法方向的鐵路維持後勤，攻城時先以野戰炮和榴彈炮壓制城郊工事，再由步兵分段推進；亞美尼亞守軍利用俄軍留下的堡壘、城防射擊孔與外圍野戰工事抵抗。札涅古爾的地形完全不同，地圖上的直線實際上是狹窄谷道，炮兵難以展開，部隊只能沿少數道路成縱隊前進，後方供應依賴馱運。雙方在梅赫里、奧爾杜巴德與納赫奇瓦凡一線反覆發動反擊，一處山口或渡口的得失常迫使另一側防線重組；實際上是數次互相咬合的局部作戰，而非一次正面會戰。
tacticsEn: In late April, Armenian forces advanced principally along the Yerevan–Kapan–Meghri road and mountain tracks into Zangezur, then divided toward Ordubad, Meghri, and Nakhchivan. Their central purpose was to open a southern route and connect Armenian formations dispersed in Zangezur and Nakhchivan. Azerbaijani and Nakhchivan troops relied on the Nakhchivan–Ordubad–Jolfa road and fixed positions along the Aras, using outposts, mounted patrols, and machine-gun fire to restrict the opposing depth. The Ottoman Army used Kars as a concentration point and sustained itself through the Kars–Tiflis and Kars–Jolfa rail directions. In the attack on Kars, field guns and howitzers first engaged the works outside the city, after which infantry advanced in limited stages; the Armenian defenders occupied former Russian casemates, firing positions, and field fortifications. Zangezur offered a very different problem. Lines that appeared direct on a map were narrow valley roads, artillery had little room to deploy, and troops had to move in column while supplies came forward by pack transport. Both sides launched repeated counterattacks around Meghri, Ordubad, and Nakhchivan, and the loss of one pass or river crossing often forced a reorganization farther along the front. The campaign therefore consisted of several interlocking local operations rather than one general engagement.
data: 可靠的時間框架始於1918年三月：三月十一日成立的南高加索委員會尚能維持部分帝國行政，四月十二日該委員會解散，俄軍陸續撤走，奧斯曼軍於四月中旬進入納赫奇瓦凡方向。一般史料把四月二十日列為戰爭的慣用起點，當時札涅古爾地區已出現正式武裝衝突；四月下旬，梅赫里、奧爾杜巴德與納赫奇瓦凡周邊陣地數度易手。五月九日，奧斯曼軍攻占卡爾斯，這是戰役中日期最明確的攻城成果。五月第二、三週，雙方在札涅古爾與納赫奇瓦凡前線再度互相反攻，至五月二十八日前後才形成較穩定的接觸線；同日，亞美尼亞與阿塞拜疆各自宣布共和國成立。六月二日，亞美尼亞與奧斯曼簽署《亞歷山德羅波爾條約》，軍事框架至此轉為條約安排；六月六日，蘇俄與阿塞拜疆簽署《莫斯科條約》，確認阿塞拜疆的國家地位及邊界框架；六月十三日，土耳其、亞美尼亞、阿塞拜疆與喬治亞共同簽署《卡爾斯條約》，把戰時控制轉成正式區域安排。由於帝國行政中斷、志願部隊名冊不全，而且兩國正式政府到五月下旬才開始運作，現有材料沒有足以支持雙方精確總傷亡的一致紀錄；因此只能確定若干日期、占領與條約結果，不能把互相矛盾的傷亡數字當作可靠統計。
dataEn: A defensible chronology begins in March 1918. The Transcaucasian Commissariat, established on 11 March, still retained part of the imperial administrative structure; it dissolved on 12 April, Russian troops began withdrawing, and an Ottoman column entered the Nakhchivan direction in mid-April. Conventional histories use 20 April as the opening date of the war, by which time armed clashes had begun in Zangezur. In late April, positions around Meghri, Ordubad, and Nakhchivan changed hands repeatedly. On 9 May, Ottoman forces captured Kars, the clearest dated fortress success of the campaign. During the second and third weeks of May, counterattacks again reshaped the Zangezur and Nakhchivan fronts, and a more stable contact line had formed by about 28 May. On that date Armenia and Azerbaijan each declared a republic. On 2 June, Armenia and the Ottoman Empire concluded the Treaty of Alexandropol, converting the military situation into a treaty framework. On 6 June, Soviet Russia and Azerbaijan signed the Treaty of Moscow, confirming Azerbaijan's statehood and the border framework. On 13 June, Turkey, Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Georgia signed the Treaty of Kars, formalizing the regional settlement. Because imperial administration had collapsed, volunteer registers were incomplete, and the two republican governments did not begin operating until late May, no single set of casualty totals is sufficiently secure. Certain dates, captures, and treaty dispositions can be stated, but conflicting casualty figures should not be presented as reliable statistics.
cause: 戰爭的直接背景是俄國統治在南高加索迅速解體，而不是某一場孤立衝突。帝國軍隊撤退後，亞美尼亞、阿塞拜疆與喬治亞的民族機構各自接管地方權力；三月《布列斯特－立托斯克條約》又為奧斯曼勢力向高加索推進打開空間。對亞美尼亞當局而言，札涅古爾是聯絡埃里溫與納赫奇瓦凡、鞏固南部側翼的關鍵；若失去它，亞美尼亞各部便難以在南部維持一條連續防線。對阿塞拜疆與納赫奇瓦凡當局而言，札涅古爾可阻止亞美尼亞把納赫奇瓦凡與其本土連成一體，因此必須限制亞美尼亞部隊向梅赫里及奧爾杜巴德推進。奧斯曼則把卡爾斯視為高加索鐵路、堡壘與東向聯絡的關鍵，並希望鞏固經納赫奇瓦凡通往阿塞拜疆的通道。俄軍離開留下的槍炮、鐵路和行政設施，使三方都能迅速擴編；四月十二日委員會解散後，地方軍政當局同時調動，鐵路沿線與山口的占領隨即把政治競爭轉成軍事衝突。
causeEn: The immediate background was the rapid disintegration of Russian rule in the South Caucasus, not an isolated local quarrel. After imperial troops departed, Armenian, Azerbaijani, and Georgian national institutions assumed local authority in their respective areas. The Treaty of Brest-Litovsk in March also opened the way for an Ottoman advance into the Caucasus. For the Armenian authorities, Zangezur was essential for linking Yerevan with Nakhchivan and securing the southern flank; without it, Armenian forces could not maintain a continuous defensive line in the south. For the Azerbaijani and Nakhchivan authorities, Zangezur prevented Armenia from joining Nakhchivan to its main territory, so Armenian movement toward Meghri and Ordubad had to be restricted. The Ottomans regarded Kars as a strategic junction of Caucasian railways, fortifications, and communications, and sought to secure a route through Nakhchivan toward Azerbaijan. Rifles, artillery, railways, and administrative sites left by the departing Russians allowed all three actors to expand their forces quickly. After the Commissariat dissolved on 12 April, local authorities moved simultaneously, and control of the rail line and mountain passes turned political competition into military operations.
impact: 最直接的結果出現在交通與戰略地帶，而不只是某一天的陣地旗幟。卡爾斯與阿爾達漢落入奧斯曼控制後，東高加索鐵路由安納托利亞方向重新編排，亞美尼亞失去北部與東部的堡壘和鐵路屏障；札涅古爾與納赫奇瓦凡則在六月條約框架中轉入阿塞拜疆的行政安排，亞美尼亞原定的南部聯絡未能固定。納赫奇瓦凡因此成為阿塞拜疆西部相對隔離的突出部，其軍事聯絡高度依賴朱爾法走廊及奧斯曼方面的協助。另一項影響是軍隊體制的重組：原先的民族委員會、志願部隊、地方民兵與俄軍殘餘單位被編入新軍，卻同時繼承混合口徑、分散鐵路和山地運補等問題，後來的衝突仍受這些結構限制。蘇俄在1918年下半年重返南高加索，六月六日《莫斯科條約》又把阿塞拜疆的承認與其邊界安排相連；亞美尼亞則在沒有卡爾斯屏障的條件下開始與奧斯曼及蘇俄周旋。就軍事地理而言，真正延續下來的成果是邊界、鐵路與指揮線的重畫。
impactEn: The most direct effects appeared along communications routes and strategic districts rather than only in the flags raised over a single battlefield. After Kars and Ardahan came under Ottoman control, the railways of eastern Transcaucasia were reorganized toward Anatolia, and Armenia lost the fortress and rail barrier in its northern and eastern approaches. Zangezur and Nakhchivan passed into the Azerbaijani administrative framework established by the June agreements, and the Armenian southern connection did not become permanent. Nakhchivan consequently became a relatively isolated western salient of Azerbaijan, with its military links heavily dependent on the Jolfa corridor and Ottoman assistance. A further consequence was the restructuring of the armed forces. Militia, volunteer detachments, local units, and residual Russian formations were absorbed into new armies, but they inherited incompatible calibers, fragmented rail supply, and difficult mountain logistics that continued to constrain later conflicts. Soviet Russia returned to the South Caucasus later in 1918, and the Treaty of Moscow on 6 June linked Azerbaijan's recognition to the new border arrangements. Armenia, meanwhile, began dealing with the Ottomans and Soviet Russia without the Kars buffer. The durable military effect was therefore the redrawing of frontiers, railways, and command lines.
result: 若只看戰場，1918年的結果並非一方全勝或全軍覆滅。奧斯曼軍在五月九日實質占領卡爾斯，是最牢固的軍事成果；亞美尼亞部隊在札涅古爾、奧爾杜巴德及納赫奇瓦凡方向曾多次改變局部控制，卻未能長期維持一條連續的南部防線。納赫奇瓦凡政府保住了主要地區，阿塞拜疆也藉六月條約保留了對納赫奇瓦凡及札涅古爾的安排；亞美尼亞則保住本土核心，卻失去卡爾斯方向、對納赫奇瓦凡的主張及通往札涅古爾的實際控制。六月二日《亞歷山德羅波爾條約》要求亞美尼亞接受奧斯曼所劃定、排除卡爾斯與阿爾達漢的邊界，放棄對納赫奇瓦凡和札涅古爾的要求，並取得奧斯曼對亞美尼亞國家地位的承認。六月六日《莫斯科條約》確認蘇俄與阿塞拜疆的相互邊界，六月十三日《卡爾斯條約》進一步把卡爾斯、阿爾達漢交由奧斯曼統治，把納赫奇瓦凡和札涅古爾列入阿塞拜疆安排，並確認亞美尼亞的剩餘邊界。因此，軍事交戰通常以四月二十日至六月二日概括，最終區域邊界則到六月十三日才完成；晚近條約確認的版圖，比任何單一階段的前線位置都更接近這場戰爭的實際結局。
resultEn: Judged only by battlefield events, the outcome of 1918 was neither a complete victory for one side nor the destruction of either army. The Ottoman capture of Kars on 9 May was the most secure military gain. Armenian forces repeatedly changed local control in Zangezur, Ordubad, and Nakhchivan, but they could not permanently maintain a continuous southern front. The Nakhchivan Government retained its principal territory, and Azerbaijan preserved the settlement placing Nakhchivan and Zangezur within its arrangements. Armenia kept its core territory but lost Kars, its claim to Nakhchivan, and effective control of Zangezur. The Treaty of Alexandropol on 2 June required Armenia to accept an Ottoman boundary excluding Kars and Ardahan, abandon its claims to Nakhchivan and Zangezur, and receive Ottoman recognition of the Armenian state. The Treaty of Moscow on 6 June confirmed the border arrangements between Soviet Russia and Azerbaijan, while the Treaty of Kars on 13 June assigned Kars and Ardahan to Ottoman rule, placed Nakhchivan and Zangezur within the Azerbaijani settlement, and confirmed Armenia's remaining boundaries. Combat is therefore conventionally summarized from 20 April to 2 June, with the final regional settlement completed on 13 June. The territorial arrangement confirmed by the later treaties is closer to the war's actual outcome than any temporary frontline position held during a single phase.
